name: B10-0414/2025 (Verts/ALE) – 10th anniversary of the detention of jailed Swedish publisher Gui Minhai in China
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 10th anniversary of the detention of jailed Swedish publisher Gui Minhai in China
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for China to release Gui Minhai, a Swedish publisher jailed for ten years, and to let him see his family, a doctor and Swedish officials. It also asks the European Union and its member states to press China on his case and on press freedom in every conversation, and to seek the release of other jailed journalists and political prisoners. The text is a statement of position; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing in law. Parliament asks the EU and member states to act and to demand Gui's release.
- **Who it affects:** Gui Minhai, other jailed journalists and political prisoners, and EU talks with China.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to EU institutions and the Chinese government; no binding action follows.
